resting.label: Resting
resting.meaning: No agent works here. Cards wait for a person or an event to move them.

working.label: Working
working.meaning: An agent works on each card here, following the steps below.

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.meaning: Cards are finished here. Their agent sessions stop.

header.revisionMeaning: Goes up each time the board is saved. If someone else saves first, you're asked to reload before saving.

editor.resetDescription: Go back to Factory's version of this board.
editor.resetBody: Every change made to this board's name and phases is replaced with Factory's version.
editor.deleteDescription: A board that still has cards cannot be deleted.
editor.deleteBody: The board and its phases are removed from this project.
editor.definedInCode: This board is defined in code, so it can't be changed here.
editor.adminsOnly: Only organization admins can change this board.
editor.staleBody: Reload to see their version. Your unsaved changes will be lost.
editor.discardBody: Your unsaved changes to this board will be lost.

phase.autoStartWhenHint: Leave empty to start every card on its own.
phase.instructionsHint: Added to the agent's prompt when the phase starts.
phase.goalHint: The agent keeps working until a judge finds this objective met. Leave empty for a single run.

phase.goalRunsInvalid: Use a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
phase.sessionHint: Phases with the same session share one agent session per card.
phase.toolsHint: Given to the session that works the card in this phase.
phase.exitToolHint: Ends the phase when it succeeds. Leave empty for none.
phase.autoApproveWhenHint: Leave empty to approve for every card.

skills.allOnBoards: Every skill runs in a board phase.
skills.description: Agents load these when they need them. Skills a phase runs are on that phase's page.
